notes: 'Evo Royal Hogs bridge spam' resolved by its label (card names and the family) to bridge spam with Royal Hogs.

this_season counts the recorded decks whose stamped archetype has that family and those win conditions in season 2026-09; players sums the decks' distinct players, so a player on two such decks counts twice. Pass the same name as archetype to battles_meta_decks for the decks themselves.

archetype is Elixir's descriptive name for a deck's shape - its win condition and family, composed from the cards and their costs - not a claim about what players call it or how it performs; several deck identities (forms) share one label, and a deck with no attested win condition is named by its cost alone.
